mapper.select: WITH filtered_article AS ( SELECT a.id, a.from_name, a.title, a.is_read, a.created_at, a.mailling_list, a.from_domain FROM article a WHERE a.to_user_id = #{userId} AND a.created_at >= make_date(#{year}, #{month}, 1) AND a.created_at < make_date(#{year}, #{month}, 1) + INTERVAL '1 month' ) SELECT fa.id, fa.from_name, fa.title, fa.is_read, fa.created_at, n.image_url FROM filtered_article fa LEFT JOIN newsletter n ON (fa.from_domain = n.domain) OR (fa.mailling_list IS NOT NULL AND fa.mailling_list = n.mailling_list);
